title: Proposal frontmatter (v1)
description: A pending change to existing knowledge, decided in the Claude Code or Codex session (0096). See spec/schema.md §11 and decision 0003.

field.description: A fact key or a field; on notion_correction a correction field of spec/cli.md §5.7, facts.<key> among them.

before.description: A fact value; on notion_correction also a note id or a list of per- ids (spec/schema.md §11); on a fix_structure (0.17.0) the field's whole value, a list included.

after.description: A fact value; on notion_correction also a note id, a list of per- ids, or null to remove an optional reference; on a fix_structure (0.17.0) the field's whole value, a list included.

section.description: 0.16.0 on (decision 0100 §3, spec/schema.md §11): on an add_to_note whose target is a whole Document kept from a task, the section its content goes to. Never folded into a review_notes.

subject.description: 0.16.0 on (0098, spec/schema.md §11, capture-and-review §7.3): the subject the ingest assigned the change to: an existing knowledge note's id, or a plain name of one line (at most 80 characters).

passages.description: 0.13.0 on (0077 §3, spec/schema.md §11.5, eligibility.md §9.1): the passages the change rests on. Absent on a legacy proposal, written before the field, and on a review_notes (its items carry them) and a notion_change.

fixes.description: On fix: the corrected values the skill read from the user's words (spec/schema.md §11.3).

item.description: a cleanup review_notes (cli.md §5.7): the it- id of a remove or independence item.

reject.description: 0.16.0 on (0098, spec/schema.md §11.3): on an approved or fixed review_notes with items, the items the user turned down: {note}, {target, field, value} or {change}; on a cleanup review_notes, {item} (cli.md §5.7).

decided_by.description: chat from 0.16.0; tick and cleanup from 0.17.0, written only by brain cleanup (a tick in a Ready Weekly row, or an item left unticked there and declined; a mechanical item the weekly run applied alone, spec/weekly-review.md §15); notion is history.

note.description: For new_item: one `brain note new` input item without id (spec/cli.md §5.5).

closed_reason.description: stale: the target changed before apply, or the proposal is withheld. withdrawn (0.16.0): a notion_correction or tracked_task sync no longer reads in Notion, closed with no decision (spec/cli.md §5.14.2).

notion_published.description: Review property name → value last published (spec/cli.md §5.14).

changes.description: review_notes only: the update_fact, update_body and add_to_note items of the same ingest (and a correction group's update_fact and replace_line items), in render order (spec/schema.md §11.3).

items.description: review_notes only (0055, capture-and-review §7.2): the independently decidable items, in the order the session lists them (changes, notes, links; spec/schema.md §11.3). `item_id` is immutable. Absent on a proposal written before 0.8.0, which keeps the 0045 behavior (§7.9).

n.description: restore only: the paragraph number to restore.

ref.description: A note id (kind note), an index into links or changes, or (a grouped link item, from 0.15.0) a list of indexes into links that share one target and field.

passages.description: note, link and change items from 0.13.0 on: the item's passages (spec/schema.md §11.5). An item without them is legacy.

repeat.description: 0.15.0: a short key shared by the items that record the same thing.

revisions.description: review_notes only, history (written before 0.16.0; capture-and-review §7.10): a Request revision per item. `requested` holds the user's instruction; `drafted` means the stored proposal was replaced by a new draft, and `previous` keeps the wording the user had in the Proposed toggle.

cleanup.description: review_notes only (capture-and-review §5.2): this is the exclusion cleanup row of an input. Its items are remove, restore and independence; `tasks` lists the Tasks created from excluded content, for the user to act on in Notion.

item_decisions.description: review_notes only: decided items, written in the same commit as their write set (capture-and-review §7.6).

agreed.description: format 2 (capture-and-review §7.12.6): the Agreed in review lines of the item's section, never hashed.

values.description: an accepted grouped link item from which values were deleted: the indexes into links that were added.

items.description: stale: a change whose target changed first (spec/schema.md §11.3). source_excluded: an item of a review_notes without items, withheld for want of eligible support (§11.5); a note or a link is only ever source_excluded.

database.description: notion_change and notion_correction: the Notion database of page (spec/schema.md §11, spec/assistant.md §6, spec/cli.md §5.14.2).

page.description: notion_change, notion_correction, tracked_task: the Notion page id, dashed and lowercase.

page_title.description: notion_change: the row's Name when proposed; tracked_task: the task's title as read, else the question's.

property.description: notion_change: tasks take status, due, project, area; projects status, archived; areas archived. notion_correction: the Notion property as sync plan reports it (Role, Key Facts/<key>).

notion_value.description: notion_correction (0.16.0, 0101 §4): N, the value Notion showed, in the normalized form of spec/cli.md §5.14.1; for Key Facts/<key>, that key's value.

observed_at.description: notion_correction: the row's last_edited when sync read the edit.

task_state.description: tracked_task (0.16.0, 0101 §6): what sync read of the task.

task_status.description: tracked_task: the status name read; null when gone or unreadable.

task_edited.description: tracked_task: the task row's last_edited when read; null when unreadable.

value_before.description: notion_change: the value read when proposed; its shape follows property.

value_after.description: notion_change: the value to write; its shape follows property.

area.description: notion_change and set_field: the Area the change belongs to, which the session names with the question.

finding.description: The Ultimate Assistant finding key (spec/assistant.md §3.3); the same pattern as assistant.schema.json $defs/findingKey.

fingerprint.description: The reflection finding the proposal records (spec/schema.md §11.4, decisions 0052 and 0076): <finding kind>:<ids or term>[:<field or source>].

line_before.description: replace_line (spec/weekly-review.md §8.3): the exact body line replaced.

line_after.description: replace_line: the line that replaces it.

tidy.description: 0.17.0 (spec/weekly-review.md §15.2): the weekly clean-up's mechanical kind. fix_structure: pair_half, moved_link or repeated_value; archive_draft: stale_draft; a merge the clean-up wrote: exact_duplicate.

task_title.description: new_task (0.17.0): the task's words, one line, written by the brain from the project's own notes and inputs, which why cites (spec/weekly-review.md §6.1).

weekly.description: 0.17.0: the week of the Weekly row that offers this proposal (an Action or a doubtful clean-up item, spec/weekly-review.md §15.6); decided by its tick there, not asked in the session.

undone_at.description: 0.17.0: when brain cleanup undo restored a mechanical item (closed_reason undone, cli.md §5.38).

correction.description: A correction group's review_notes (spec/weekly-review.md §8.4): the claim key it corrects, <target>:<field>, <decision id> or <target>:rule:<proposal id>.

needs_clarification.description: A correction group's uncertain matches, named and not drafted (spec/weekly-review.md §8.4).

evidence.description: Reflection: the meetings and sources the finding rested on when the user answered it, sorted and unique (spec/schema.md §11.4); may be empty (a duplicate rests on names).

allOf.description: replace_line (0.15.0): one exact line of the target's body, with its body hash.
line_before and line_after belong to replace_line, and from 0.17.0 to a moved_link fix_structure.
archive_draft (0.17.0): a never-reviewed draft archived by the clean-up's stale_draft.
fix_structure (0.17.0): one structural fix; pair_half and repeated_value change field from before to after, moved_link replaces line_before with line_after.
new_task (0.17.0): a next-step task for its project, created in Notion on the user's tick; no passages.
tidy belongs to fix_structure, archive_draft and a merge (exact_duplicate).
task_title belongs to new_task.
tidy:stale_draft:… is an archive_draft; tidy:pair_half, moved_link and repeated_value are fix_structure.
undone (0.17.0): a mechanical item applied alone (decided_by cleanup), then undone; undone_at says when.
correction and needs_clarification belong to a correction group's review_notes.
A reflection proposal (0052, 0076) carries its fingerprint and its evidence together, and is never an Ultimate Assistant one.
contradiction:<target>:<field> is a contradiction on that target and field.
stale:<target>:<field> is an update_fact on that target and field.
merge:<id>+<id> is a merge of those two notes.
section (0.16.0, decision 0100 §3) only on an add_to_note.
promotion:<target>:<source> is an add_to_note on that target from that source.
theme:<term> is the draft learned Document's review_notes (a yes or later), or a new_item (a skip).
notion_change (0072): its own fields, no fact or note fields.
A review_notes names its passages per item (spec/schema.md §11.5), not as a whole.
value_before and value_after belong to notion_change only.
database and property belong to notion_change and notion_correction.
page belongs to notion_change, notion_correction and tracked_task; page_title to notion_change and tracked_task.
notion_change: its databases and properties (spec/assistant.md §6).
notion_correction (0.16.0, 0101 §4): an edit to a brain-owned value found in Notion, written only by sync apply; no passages.
notion_value and observed_at belong to notion_correction.
A field of the facts.<key> form, a null after and a list value belong to notion_correction.
tracked_task (0.16.0, 0101 §6): a tracked question's task finished, in the trash or unreadable; written only by sync apply; no passages.
A tracked_task's state: a status on done or dropped; null on gone and unreadable; no last edit on unreadable.
task_state, task_status and task_edited belong to tracked_task.
A tracked_task is decided with fix ({answer} or {drop: true}) or reject, never approve or edit (spec/schema.md §11.1).
withdrawn (0.16.0): a notion_correction or tracked_task closed by sync apply, with no decision.
area belongs to notion_change and set_field only.
A task has no note: no target; tasks take status, due, project, area.
projects: the project note is the target; Status or Archived.
areas: the Area note is the target; Archived only.
status: a string, or null before; never null after.
A project's Status is one of its four options.
due: a date or null.
project and area: a sorted, duplicate-free list of page ids.
archived: a boolean.
set_field (0072, 0092): the area of a project, decision, question, Document or source, or an Area's domain, as note ids.

anyOf.description: The exclusion cleanup row (capture-and-review §5.2): it holds only cleanup items.

allOf.description: exclude entries fit the kind: {field, value} on add_link, {note} or {target, field, value} on review_notes.

passage.description: A passage reference src-…#¶<n>:<hash> (capture-and-review §5.1), or an input with no paragraph identities, or an entry that names no input (spec/schema.md §11).

correctionList.description: notion_correction: a note id (a reference field) or a list of per- ids (people).

normalizedValue.description: A Notion value in spec/cli.md §5.14.1's normalized form: text, number, checkbox, a {start, end} date, a sorted list of page ids, or null.
